title: Song of Praise for God's Favor

questions.question: O LORD, you are my God; I will exalt you; I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, plans formed of old, faithful and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 25:1 (ESV): "plans formed of old, faithful and sure."

questions.question: For you have made the city a heap, the fortified city a what?
Therefore strong peoples will glorify you; cities of ruthless nations will do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 25:3 (ESV): "cities of ruthless nations will fear you."

questions.question: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 25:4 (ESV): "a stronghold to the needy in his distress,"

questions.question: A shelter from the storm and a shade from the what?
On this mountain the LORD of hosts will make for all peoples a feast of what food?
A feast of well-aged wine, of rich food full of marrow, of aged wine well what?
And he will swallow up on this mountain the covering that is cast over all peoples, the veil that is spread over all what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 25:7 (ESV): "the veil that is spread over all nations."

questions.question: He will swallow up death for how long?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 25:8 (ESV): "He will swallow up death forever;"

questions.question: And the Lord GOD will wipe away what from all faces?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 25:8 (ESV): "And the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from all faces,"

questions.question: It will be said on that day, "Behold, this is our God; we have waited for him, that he might save us. This is the whom?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 25:9 (ESV): "This is the LORD; we have waited for him;"

questions.question: For the hand of the LORD will rest on this mountain, and who shall be trampled down in his place?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 25:10 (ESV): "and Moab shall be trampled down in his place,"

questions.question: As straw is trampled down in a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 25:10 (ESV): "as straw is trampled down in a dunghill."

questions.question: And he will spread out his hands in the midst of it as a what spreads his hands to swim?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 25:11 (ESV): "as a swimmer spreads his hands to swim,"

questions.question: And the high fortifications of his walls he will bring down, lay low, and cast to the ground, to the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 25:12 (ESV): "cast to the ground, to the dust."

key_verse_text: He will swallow up death forever; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from all faces, and the reproach of his people he will take away from all the earth, for the LORD has spoken.
